fig.title: 2.4 seconds sample of the Vibration Z time waveform

li.p: Figure 23 is a waveform graph showing time waveform data from the Z-axis sensor.

ul.li: The graph’s X-axis shows the time in seconds.
The graph’s Y-Axis shows the time waveform in metre per second squared (m/s2) at the 6.25 kHz sample frequency.

fig.title: Zoomed-in view of the 2.4 seconds sample of Vibration Z time waveform between 0.95 seconds and 1.45 seconds

li.p: Figure 25: Zoomed-in view of the 2.4 seconds sample of Vibration Z time waveform between 0.2 seconds and 0.6 seconds
Figure 24 and 25 show a zoomed-in view of the waveform graph showing Fast Fourier Transform data from the Z-axis sensor.

ul.li: The graph’s X-axis shows the time in seconds.
The graph’s Y-Axis shows the time waveform in metre per second squared (m/s2) at 6.2 KHz sample frequency.
